newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania refinancing loans rise in October.
newsitem.headline: Romania refinancing loans rise in October.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday refinancing loans went up by 18.41 percent in October with structural and auctioned credits on the rise.
BNR data showed the bank gave no Lombard loans in October. The Lombard loans, which charge an annual 90 percent interest, stood at 5.4 billion lei in September.
Structural facilities rose to around 1.02 trillion lei in October from 755.4 billion in September, while auctioned credits expanded to 1.09 trillion lei from 429.2 billion lei.
Support given to "debtors in dispute at law" stayed flat at 1.87 trillion lei. The BNR does not charge interest on loans to those debtors.

Average annual interest rates charged for each type of BNR refinancing windows were flat at 35 percent for structural loans and fell to 49 percent from 54 for one-week funds. ($=3,591 lei) -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
